get.description:
The datasets, LFW verification, CelebA identification, the first active model, learning,
the bias breakdown and the live operating points. `503 evaluation_unavailable` when the
service started without them.

put.description:
Switch the active model: `409 cannot_be_active` for a model that is unavailable or not
evaluated. The live monitor is told, and its next frame is judged by the new model.

patch.description:
Rename, remove or restore a person of interest; an empty body changes nothing. Removal
takes them off the watchlist the live monitor matches against from its next frame.

delete.description:
Purge a person of interest, on the watchlist or removed: their enrolled photos,
embeddings and sightings are erased, and they are cleared as runner-up on other sightings.
Not reversible.

200.description: The enrolled photo, upright and without metadata

get.description:
Sightings newest first, of one person of interest if `personId` is given. `cursor` is
the previous page's `nextCursor`; any other value is `422 invalid_cursor`.

200.description: The face of the sighting's best match, never the whole frame

ActiveModelChoice.title: ActiveModelChoice
ActiveModelChoice.description:
The model to make active. Any other field, such as a threshold, is refused with
`422 invalid_request`: thresholds come from evaluation only.

AtThreshold.title: AtThreshold
AtThreshold.description: The test draw's rates at the threshold frozen on the validation draw.

CelebaDataset.title: CelebaDataset
CelebaDataset.description: One CelebA draw before any gallery is chosen.

DetectionCounts.title: DetectionCounts
DetectionCounts.description: How YuNet did on one dataset or draw, in images.

Eligibility.title: Eligibility
Eligibility.description: One model judged by the rule, with the numbers each test was judged on.

EvaluationReport.title: EvaluationReport
EvaluationReport.description:
Everything the evaluation page shows, from `eda/summary.json` and `evaluation/results.json`.
A section is None until the command that measures it has run.

Gain.title: Gain
Gain.description: A method's test TPIR at `targetFpir` minus the baseline's, with its paired interval.

GroupRates.title: GroupRates
GroupRates.description:
One group's test-draw rates at the model's single frozen threshold. A rate is None when
fewer than `minIdentities` identities stand behind it.

Hyperparameter.title: Hyperparameter
Hyperparameter.description: A classifier's hyperparameter, chosen on the validation draw.

Interval.title: Interval
Interval.description: A 95% interval. On a gain, a difference of rates, so `low` may be negative.

LfwGate.title: LfwGate
LfwGate.description: The LFW test as the rule applied it.

MethodComparison.title: MethodComparison
MethodComparison.description: One method fitted and frozen on the validation draw, then scored on the test draw.

ModelRef.title: ModelRef
ModelRef.description: A recognition model as evaluation measured it.

OpenSetCurve.title: OpenSetCurve
OpenSetCurve.description:
TPIR against FPIR on the test draw, paired by index, about 200 points spaced evenly in log
FPIR; the first may have FPIR 0.

OpenSetDraw.title: OpenSetDraw
OpenSetDraw.description: How one CelebA draw was split into gallery and held-out identities.

OpenSetResult.title: OpenSetResult
OpenSetResult.description: One model's watchlist rehearsal, on the test draw.

PersonOfInterestChanges.title: PersonOfInterestChanges
PersonOfInterestChanges.description:
What PATCH changes: the name, the status, both or neither. A field left out is left as it
is; null, or any other field such as `statusChangedAt`, is refused with
`422 invalid_request` rather than ignored. A new name another person of interest already
has is refused with `409 warnings` until resent with `duplicate_name` acknowledged.

Rate.title: Rate
Rate.description: A rate over probes or pairs with its 95% identity-level percentile bootstrap interval.

RocCurve.title: RocCurve
RocCurve.description: FAR against TAR from (0, 0) to (1, 1), paired by index.

SamePersonRates.title: SamePersonRates
SamePersonRates.description: The same-person warning on the test draw with `enrolledPhotos` photos per identity.

SfaceInt8.title: SfaceInt8
SfaceInt8.description: Why Ryuk runs SFace fp32, not int8: the int8 weights on the same View 2 pairs and faces.

Sighting.title: Sighting
Sighting.description: One sighting with the runner-up at its best match.

SightingPerson.description: A sighting's person of interest, or its runner-up, as they are now.
SightingPerson.title: SightingPerson

SightingSummary.description:
A sighting as the history lists it and the live monitor announces it. Never carries the
runner-up.
SightingSummary.title: SightingSummary

SmallGallery.title: SmallGallery
SmallGallery.description:
The live rule at its frozen threshold on the test draw split into galleries of
`identities` each; non-mated probes count once per gallery.

TarAtFar.title: TarAtFar
TarAtFar.description: TAR at the lowest threshold whose FAR is at or below the target.

TpirAtFpir.title: TpirAtFpir
TpirAtFpir.description:
TPIR at the lowest threshold whose FPIR on the test draw itself is at or below the target:
a reading of the test curve, not the frozen threshold's rates.

VerificationReport.title: VerificationReport
VerificationReport.description: LFW View 2 under the 10-fold recipe, one result per model.

ActiveModelChanged.description: The active model was switched; the next frame's result is judged by it.
ActiveModelChanged.title: ActiveModelChanged

FaceBox.description: A face's box in the pixels of the frame it was found in. Not clipped to the frame.
FaceBox.title: FaceBox

FrameResult.description: Every face in one frame, judged by the active model at its threshold.
FrameResult.title: FrameResult

MonitorError.description:
A message that could not be used as a frame, or a frame whose recognition failed
unexpectedly (`internal_error`). The connection stays open.
MonitorError.title: MonitorError

MonitorMessage.description: Every message the service sends on `/api/monitor`, by `type`.
MonitorMessage.title: MonitorMessage

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem detail with Ryuk's `code` extension.
Problem.title: Problem

SightingEnded.description:
A sighting ended: the person went unmatched long enough, the live monitor stopped, the
active model was switched, or the person was removed or purged.
SightingEnded.title: SightingEnded

SightingOpened.description:
A person of interest's matches were confirmed and their sighting opened. Sent before the
result of the frame that confirmed it, which already carries the sighting's ID.
SightingOpened.title: SightingOpened

SightingUpdated.description:
An open sighting's progress was written: when the person was last seen, or a better
match. The runner-up is never sent live.
SightingUpdated.title: SightingUpdated

TooSmallFace.description: A detection too small to use: never scored.
TooSmallFace.title: TooSmallFace

WarningsProblem.description: `409 warnings`: resend with every listed code in `acknowledgedWarnings` to proceed.
WarningsProblem.title: WarningsProblem
